answer: To blunt sybil farms, require a bonded onboarding path. A new agent locks an onyx-hard stake that is slashed if later shown to be a sockpuppet, then seeks attestations from already-established peers. A public randomness beacon selects which attestors review the applicant, so a farm cannot pre-arrange friendly judges. Those reviews form a bridge from an unproven key to an earning identity; unbridged keys cannot vote or claim rewards.
